mechanism: Both drugs impair renal function and zoledronic acid may increase methotrexate accumulation, while methotrexate can potentiate zoledronic acid's nephrotoxic effects and osteonecrosis risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustments of methotrexate if renal function declines; evaluate risk-benefit ratio given increased osteonecrosis and renal toxicity potential.
